Name: Bog's Witchy Tilesheets
Author: BogWyytch
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/tTVwC6YB/retro-bookcase-(10).png[/img]

This mod is created for mod authors to use as a resource and as a [b]DEPENDENCY[/b] on any mod that is created using these tiles. Just so you, as a player, are aware this mod does [u]nothing[/u] on its own. You will need to download mods that utilize this mod. 

[center][u][b][size=5]MOD AUTHORS[/size][/b][/u][/center]
Please do not include these assets in your mod folders and please do not share any of these files. That is asset theft. 
No changes to these tilesheets are currently permitted. 
If you would anything added please leave us a comment and if it fits with the vision of these tilesheets we will consider adding it.

[b][u]How To Use;[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Download Bog's Witchy Tilesheets
[*]Use the tilesheets the same way you would use vanilla tilesheets (we recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40281]Tilesheetinator[/url] to manage your tilesheets)
[*]Add the tilesheet mod as a [b][u]dependency[/u][/b] in your manifest and on your mod page
[*]HAVE SO MUCH FUN!
[/list]
 [img]https://i.postimg.cc/KYQBkpg2/stone-wall.png[/img]
[center][u][b][size=5]ACCESSIBILITY[/size][/b][/u][/center]
[b][u]Vision[/u][/b]
   [u][i]Stardew Access[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]This mod has not yet been tested for compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16205]Stardew Access[/url].
[*]However, the only changes made to the game by this mod are visual - there are no other features.
[/list]
   [u][i]Trypophobia[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]This mod should be trypophobia safe.
[*]Please let us know if there are any sprites we do need to warn about.
[/list]
[b][u]Sound[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]This mod contains no sounds of any kind.
[/list]
We welcome requests for any additional accessibility changes our players may need.

[center][u][b][size=5]COMPATIBILITY[/size][/b][/u][/center]
[list]
[*]We do not currently provide compatibility for any recolour mods.
[*]However, this mod naturally pairs well with the colours in DaisyNiko's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url]/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]Interiors[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28948]Aimon's Witchy Dirt and Grass Recolor[/url].
[/list]

[center][u][b][size=5]UNINSTALLATION[/size][/b][/u][/center]
[list]
[*]You can uninstall this mod at any time.
[*]Delete any mods that require it.
[*]Then delete this mod's folder.
[/list]
